prompt: Both rowing clubs share the same gym beside the river. Our training equipment is just (good) theirs, so we do not need new machines. Still, their team wakes up (early) than we do and practises much (hard) than we do before breakfast. That is why they won the spring race.
explanation_ru: Равенство передаёт «just as good as», а действия команд сравниваются через наречия «earlier» и «harder».

prompt: The clearer your notes are, ___ the test will be.
explanation_ru: В парной конструкции «the ..., the ...» артикль «the» обязателен в обеих частях, причём используется сравнительная степень «the easier», а не превосходная.

prompt: Mateo noticed the green shelf was five centimetres more long than the window.
answer: Mateo noticed the green shelf was five centimetres longer than the window.
accepted_answers: Mateo noticed the green shelf was five centimetres longer than the window.
explanation_ru: Короткое односложное прилагательное «long» образует сравнительную степень с помощью суффикса «-er» («longer»), а не «more long».

prompt: Our previous flat was bigger than this new one. → This new flat isn't …
answer: This new flat isn't as big as our previous one.
accepted_answers: This new flat isn't as big as our previous one.
This new flat isn't as big as our previous flat.
This new flat is not as big as our previous one.
This new flat is not as big as our previous flat.
This new flat isn't so big as our previous one.
This new flat isn't so big as our previous flat.
explanation_ru: Перефразирование сравнения «bigger than» через отрицание строится по модели «isn't as big as» (или «so big as»).

prompt: Snow fell silently on our village all afternoon. The white layer on the roof grew (thick) and (thick), and the buses moved (slowly) down the hill than they had before the snow. Did we bring (few / bags) of salt than we needed for the front steps? Let's clear the path before the frost freezes it.
explanation_ru: Постепенный рост слоя передаёт «thicker and thicker», движение описывает наречие «more slowly», а с исчисляемым «bags» требуется «fewer».

prompt: These two café chairs have soft cushions and give your back the same support.
options: The window chair is much more comfortable than the wooden one.
The wooden chair is less comfortable than the window chair.
This chair is just as comfortable as the other one.
Neither chair is as comfortable as a hard bench.
explanation_ru: Одинаковый уровень удобства выражается конструкцией равенства «just as comfortable as».

prompt: Commuters on the number 42 bus route have complained to the council twice this month. Because of roadworks, the morning timetable is becoming (little) and (little) predictable. Drivers don't arrive on time, so people spend (much / time) freezing at the stop and catch (few / trains) at the station. I have started walking to work whenever the rain stops.
explanation_ru: Убывание признака выражается парой «less and less predictable»; далее «more time» (больше времени) и «fewer trains» с исчисляемым существительным.

prompt: Priya tested a free running app during her weekend training in the park. Its distance tracker wasn't (nearly / accurate) her sports watch, which tracks the route with GPS. Still, the app gave (useful) advice on her pace than her old notebook did, and it warned her (quickly) than her watch when she slowed down. She decided to keep both tools for her marathon preparation.
explanation_ru: Отрицательное сравнение с усилителем строится как «wasn't nearly as accurate as»; далее многосложное прилагательное «more useful» и наречие «more quickly».

prompt: Steaming the vegetables in a metal basket is ___ boiling them, and it keeps their bright colour.
options: just as quick a way as
just as a quick way as
just so quick a way as
explanation_ru: Перед исчисляемым существительным в ед. ч. в конструкции «as ... as» артикль «a» ставится между прилагательным и существительным: «as quick a way as».

prompt: Tomasz noted that the autumn fire drill was much more thorough than the spring test, which had involved only one floor.
answer: Tomasz noted that the autumn fire drill was much more thorough than the spring test, which had involved only one floor.
accepted_answers: Tomasz noted that the autumn fire drill was much more thorough than the spring test, which had involved only one floor.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: усилитель «much» правильно сочетается со сравнительной степенью «more thorough than».

prompt: If hikers have a clear map, they take fewer wrong turns. → The clearer the map is, …
answer: The clearer the map is, the fewer wrong turns hikers take.
accepted_answers: The clearer the map is, the fewer wrong turns hikers take.
The clearer the map is, the fewer wrong turns they take.
explanation_ru: Вторая часть конструкции «the ..., the ...» начинается со сравнительной группы «the fewer wrong turns», за которой следует прямой порядок слов.

prompt: The old paper application was more complicated than the new online form. → The new online form isn't …
answer: The new online form isn't as complicated as the old paper application.
accepted_answers: The new online form isn't as complicated as the old paper application.
The new online form isn't so complicated as the old paper application.
The new online form is not as complicated as the old paper application.
The new online form is not so complicated as the old paper application.
The new online form isn't as complicated as the old one.
The new online form isn't so complicated as the old one.
explanation_ru: Сравнение «more complicated than» переписывается в обратную сторону через «isn't as complicated as» (или «so complicated as»).

prompt: Please rewrite the safety notice on the lift door so that the instructions sound so clear as possible.
answer: Please rewrite the safety notice on the lift door so that the instructions sound as clear as possible.
accepted_answers: Please rewrite the safety notice on the lift door so that the instructions sound as clear as possible.
explanation_ru: В утвердительном устойчивом выражении «насколько возможно» используется «as ... as possible», а не «so ... as possible».

prompt: Seven local residents submitted ideas for redesigning our small neighbourhood park. Chioma's sketch was (by / far / detailed) plan in the folder, with paths, benches and a pond. Her idea of banning all cars from the side street felt (a / bit / bold) than the council had expected. Would neighbours support it (warmly) than the plain grass design?
explanation_ru: Усилитель «by far» стоит перед «the most detailed», небольшая степень различия — «a bit bolder», а способ поддержки передаёт наречие «more warmly».

prompt: Training for a charity cycling event turned out to be full of surprises. With each uphill session, the route felt (more / and / tiring), and my knees didn't feel as strong as I hoped. My coach advised me to sleep much (well) before long rides and to pedal (steadily) than I had during our first session. Within a month, I finished the whole loop without stopping.
explanation_ru: Для многосложного прилагательного нарастание передаётся как «more and more tiring»; далее наречия «better» (исключение от «well») и «more steadily».

prompt: Users compared four free library websites designed for students studying from home. The updated portal has (complete) collection of past exam papers on the web. Even with hundreds of extra files, it remains just (as / easy / site) to search as the older version, and pages load (fast) on cheap phones than they used to. Teachers now link directly to it in their reading lists.
explanation_ru: Выделение лучшего портала из всех требует «the most complete», конструкция равенства с существительным — «as easy a site as», а скорость загрузки — наречие «faster».

prompt: Pavel read the revised sales plan for our chain of bookshops before Friday's meeting. On the surface, the summer target looked just (hopeful) the spring estimate. However, the regional managers found the rental figures (far / doubtful) than the bright summary suggested, and they warned that the company couldn't hire (many / staff) as it had promised. Several branches asked for a calmer second draft.
explanation_ru: Видимое равенство выражается через «as hopeful as», усиленное сравнение — через «far more doubtful», а в отрицании перед «as» нужно «as many staff».

prompt: Repeated winter storms left the coastal youth hostel heavily in debt. Financially, the small charity did (badly) than at any point in its history, while the insurer's new repair rules were (strict) ones the trustees had ever faced. Determined to stay open, local volunteers worked (hard) than ever before to paint the dormitories themselves. Their efforts persuaded two local firms to donate new beds.
explanation_ru: Наречие «badly» имеет неправильную форму «worse», связка с «ever faced» требует превосходной степени «the strictest», а «worked» сочетается с «harder».

prompt: Inspecting each parcel by hand is as reliable like scanning it with a machine, though considerably slower during busy holiday shifts.
answer: Inspecting each parcel by hand is as reliable as scanning it with a machine, though considerably slower during busy holiday shifts.
accepted_answers: Inspecting each parcel by hand is as reliable as scanning it with a machine, though considerably slower during busy holiday shifts.
explanation_ru: В конструкции равенства после «as + прилагательное» нельзя ставить «like» — парным элементом всегда выступает второе «as».

prompt: Two teams studied town-centre shops: both reports matter equally, but the smaller team expects falling sales while the main team predicts steady growth.
options: The smaller team's report is less relevant than the main one, though its forecast is just as hopeful.
The smaller team's report is just as relevant as the main one, yet its outlook is less optimistic than that of the larger group.
The smaller team's report is much more optimistic than the main one, even though both teams expect falling sales.
The smaller team's report is just as optimistic as the main one, because neither group expects shop sales to grow.
explanation_ru: Одинаковая важность отчётов передана через «just as relevant as», а более пессимистичный прогноз — через «less optimistic than that of the larger group».

prompt: Once a coach gathers a larger group of players, the fitness score becomes more reliable. → The larger the group of players a coach gathers, …
answer: The larger the group of players a coach gathers, the more reliable the fitness score becomes.
accepted_answers: The larger the group of players a coach gathers, the more reliable the fitness score becomes.
explanation_ru: Вторая часть пропорционального сравнения начинается с «the more reliable», после чего идут подлежащее «the fitness score» и глагол «becomes».
